source.label: Tekken 1 PlayStation move and combo archive
source.note: Commands use 1/2/3/4 notation. Combo routes start when the launcher connects.

portraits.credit: Original game artwork: Namco. Portrait sheet extracted by Unstabledproton; archived by The Spriters Resource.
portraits.note: The original game uses the same select portrait for Yoshimitsu and Kunimitsu.

throws.name: Chin Bash
throws.notes: Continue into either Leg Scissors Arm Snap or Sidestep Arm Snap.

moves.name: Flipkick
moves.notes: Start crouching. Use ub, u or uf.

moves.name: Lightning Flipkick
moves.notes: Start crouching. Use ub, u or uf. Tap the upward direction.

chains.name: Sidestep Arm Snap
chains.notes: During Chin Bash. Can continue into Falling Arm Snap or Double Arm Snap.

moves.name: Spinning Drop Kick/Dive
moves.notes: Keep holding forward through the dive follow-up.

pounces.name: Elbow Drop
pounces.notes: Can also use u instead of uf.

chains.name: Aerial Piledriver
chains.notes: During Suplex, enter the follow-up before the opponent passes the vertical position.

moves.name: Sweep, Roundhouse
moves.notes: Time the second 3 after the first sweep finishes, before Heihachi rises.

combos.name: Uppercut into power punch and kick
Power uppercut into double axe kick
combos.notes: Release the direction to neutral before 4,4.

unblockables.name: Windup Punch
unblockables.notes: Continue counterclockwise rotations until the fifth windup, then press 1.
